title: ship-playbook-roadmap-heatmap
summary: Compact playbook combining milestone roadmap, KPI mapping, and a color-coded risk/ready heatmap plus a concise preflight (go-live) checklist for feature shipments.
body:
Purpose

Quick reference for product-ops and cross-functional partners to understand which roadmap milestones are tracking to business KPIs, where the risk hotspots are, and what minimal preflight items must be green before authorizing a ship window. Designed to be used in weekly PM/Eng/Design syncs as a single-pane status.

How to read the heatmap and scoring
- Each milestone row maps to 4 KPI columns: Adoption (A), Latency SLO (L), Cost per 1k tokens (C), and Quality/regression risk (Q).
- Each KPI has a score: G (green = on-target), Y (yellow = caution), R (red = blocker).
- Heatmap summary uses fastest-failure rule: any R in KPIs => milestone flagged R. Two Ys => Y. All Gs => G.
- Owners listed for accountability; 'next action' is the immediate owner step to move a Y->G or R->Y.

Roadmap Milestones x KPI Heatmap (text table)
Columns: Milestone | ETA | Owner | Adoption (A) | Latency (L) | Cost (C) | Quality (Q) | Heatmap | Next action (owner)
1) conversational-sdks: native-streaming | 2026-02-15 | Priya D. | G | Y | G | Y | Y | finalize backpressure test (eng: Noah)
2) dedicated-auto-scaling-v2 | 2026-03-01 | Ravi K. | Y | G | Y | G | Y | tune autoscale window & add extra perf test (infra: Liam)
3) private-vpc-deployments: 1st customer | 2026-03-20 | Maya T. | Y | Y | R | Y | R | encryption config w/ customer KMS (security: Sofia)
4) optimize-batching-suggestions | 2026-04-05 | Sofia C. | G | G | G | G | G | N/A (on-track)
5) rollout-function-calls-beta | 2026-04-20 | Priya D. | Y | R | Y | R | R | fix function output schema & add e2e (product: Priya)

Notes on each KPI column (short)
- Adoption: early signal = opt-in rate in pilot orgs; target = 15% of active keys in first 30 days. Data source: usage-sheets/feature-adoption.
- Latency: P95 end-to-end request latency vs baseline. SLO for GA = <= 220ms token-serving; yellow = 220-350ms; red = >350ms.
- Cost: modeled cost per 1k tokens given current batching and KV cache assumptions. Yellow if projected > +15% vs baseline. Red if > +30%.
- Quality: regression risk estimated from eval suite and canary diffs. Red if regressions > 2% in golden prompt set.

Preflight (go-live) checklist - minimal must be green for any ship window
- API contract: schema pinned and contract test passing (owner: API).
- e2e canary: 7-day canary run with traffic steering & quick rollback (owner: SRE).
- Perf: perf harness passes target SLOs on staging infra with 95% representative load (owner: Infrastructure).
- Observability: tracing & per-route cost telemetry enabled and dashboards created (owner: Observability).
- Security & compliance: threat model reviewed; KMS/HSM keys verified for private deployments (owner: Security).
- Backwards compatibility: client SDKs or SDK matrix documented; compatibility tests pass (owner: DevEx).
- Runbook: incident runbook + rollback plan + on-call roster for first 72h post-ship (owner: SRE/Product).
- Legal/comms: customer comms draft + website docs + pricing update approved (owner: GTM).
- Billing: metering validated end-to-end, billing events audited on sample run (owner: Finance).
- Data residency (if applicable): test customer data path and audit logs (owner: Privacy).

Decision rubric (quick):
- Green: all required preflight items green, heatmap for milestone not R => authorize ship.
- Yellow: single non-blocking Y and mitigations defined with owners and timelines <= 48h => consider timeboxed canary.
- Red: any preflight blocker or milestone R => block ship until remediated.

Open risks & mitigation log (short)
- Private VPC first customer: KMS integration failing some HSM cert chains (risk = high). Mitigation: escalate to infra/security, prepare manual key upload path, extend pilot window. (owner: Sofia).
- Function-call schema instability: failing golden prompts in canary (risk = high). Mitigation: freeze schema, roll back callers, run daily retinal tests. (owner: Priya).
- Cost model uncertainty for multi-tenant batching: tolerance band wide; mitigation: run 10 synthetic workloads to tighten estimate. (owner: Ravi).

Action items (next 7 days)
- Noah: finish streaming backpressure test harness and post results (due 2026-03-03).
- Liam: run autoscale stress scenario with 2x baseline traffic and publish latency scatterplot (due 2026-03-04).
- Priya: lock function-call API schema and create migration notes for integrators (due 2026-03-02).
- Sofia: open escalation ticket for KMS cert chains and convene triage (due 2026-03-01).

Meeting cadence and usage
- Use this doc in Tuesday product-ops triage (15min) to update heatmap status.
- During weekly cross-functional sync (Weds), dive into R/Y items deeper with owners.
- Copy the heatmap summary into the executive one-pager for Friday updates.

History / revision notes
- v0.1 (2025-11-02) initial fold-in of Q1 milestones and rough KPI thresholds.
- v0.3 (2026-01-15) added risk scoring & preflight checklist refinements.
- v0.5 (2026-02-28) current — rebalanced cost thresholds after infra perf runs.

Questions for reviewers
- Do we want to treat Cost C as a soft gate for early access vs hard gate for GA? (cc: Finance, Product)
- Is the latency SLO threshold reasonable for private deployments with noisy network variability? (cc: Infra, SRE)
- Should we add a dedicated column for "observability maturity" in the next iteration?
